ngmodel.why: The bridge directive keeps `require:'ngModel'` and uses `ngModel.$render` and `$setViewValue`, so `vm.contact.tags` still updates.

validity.why: The bridge re-registers `$validators.maxTags` with the same default of 5 and keeps the custom `$isEmpty`, so `$error.maxTags` and `required` (and so the Save button and error messages) behave as before.

touched.why: `onChange`, which handles both add and remove, calls `ngModel.$setTouched()` inside `scope.$apply`.

digest.why: The `$setViewValue` and `$setTouched` calls are wrapped in `scope.$apply(...)`, and the summary says so.

enter-trim.why: `onKeyDown` trims the draft, requires a non-empty value, calls `e.preventDefault()` on Enter, and appends the tag; the × link filters the tag out.

no-silent-changes.why: The added `max` watcher and unmount on `$destroy` are called out as 'two small additions', and the emptied legacy directive file is also flagged.
